title: 第16章 人贩子比杀人犯还可恶-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》
content:
第(1/3)页

    马建国整个人都懵了，等反应过来的时候，头被死死按住，脸紧紧的贴在柜门上，动弹不得。

    他瞬间剧烈挣扎起来，嘴里发出呜呜的闷响，腿使劲蹬着地面，想要挣脱。

    可他毕竟是个快五十岁的人了，二十多年的安稳日子早就磨掉了他年轻时的那点狠劲，哪里是两个常年训练的刑警的对手，不过两三秒，就被反剪了双手，彻底按死在了原地。

    几乎是同时，守在门口的另外三个队员立刻冲了进去，两个人守住前门，两个人快步绕到后门，把所有能逃跑的路线全部堵死。

    整个过程快得离谱，从进店到控制住人，前后不过十几秒，旁边摆摊的小贩、路过的行人，甚至都没察觉到这家小小的小卖部里发生了什么。

    顾承安在路口的路灯下站着，虽然看不到小卖部里的情况，却能看到巷口的队员们都稳住了身形，没有出现混乱，心里悬着的石头终于落了地，悄悄松了口气。

    过了一会，巷口的人流里，两个便衣队员一左一右架着个穿黑色外套的男人走了出来，男人的脑袋耷拉着，脚步虚浮，整个人像是被抽走了骨头，外套的袖子垂下来，遮住了手腕上的手铐。苏楠跟在后面，手里拿着一个证物袋，里面装着马建国的身份证和手机，快步朝着顾承安的方向走了过来。

    走到近前，苏楠紧绷着的脸终于松了下来：“确认了，就是马建国。他自己刚被按住就招了，跑了二十六年，终于落网了。”

    “可以啊苏警官。”顾承安咧嘴一笑，冲她竖了个大拇指，语气里带着真心的佩服，“我还以为得费点劲，没想到简简单单就搞定了，一点动静都没闹出来，太专业了。”

    “少贫嘴。”苏楠被他逗得不禁莞尔一笑，摇了摇头，认真道，“这次真的要谢谢你。这案子压了二十六年，我们警方追了全国十几个省市，一点线索都没有，要不是你发现了线索，还不知道他要藏到什么时候。”

    “嗨，就是举手之劳。”顾承安摆摆手，脸上的笑意淡去，心里也跟着有点发酸，“能把这老东西抓住，那些被拐的孩子，还有那些等着消息的家属，也算有个交代了。”

    苏楠郑重地点了点头，随即像是想起了什么，再次叮嘱道：“以后再遇到这种事，哪怕再晚，记得第一时间打电话给我，千万别自己一个人盯着，这些罪犯大多都带着破罐子破摔的狠劲，太危险了。”

    “放心，我惜命得很。”

    “我就是个送外卖的，顶多就是眼睛尖点，抓人的事，肯定还是得靠你们专业的。对了苏警官，这次抓了A级通缉犯，我这见义勇为好市民的奖，是不是能安排上了？”顾承安笑着调侃道。

    苏楠被他逗得笑出了声，点了点头：“你放心！我回去就给你提交材料，不仅有荣誉证书，还有专项奖金，肯定少不了你的。”

    “那我可就等着了啊。”顾承安笑得眉眼弯弯。

    说话间，队员已经把马建国押上了那辆宏光。

    顾承安看着两辆车消失在路口，心里莫名的踏实。

    心念一动，打开系统。

    【正义值：1055】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ma Jianguo was completely stunned. When he came to his senses, his head was pressed tightly and his face was pressed tightly against the cabinet door, unable to move.

He struggled violently in an instant, making a muffled sound from his mouth, kicking his legs hard on the ground, trying to get free.

But after all, he is almost fifty years old, and more than twenty years of stable life have long worn away the ruthlessness of his youth. He is no match for two criminal policemen who have been trained all year round. In just two or three seconds, his hands were cut behind his back and he was completely pinned to death.

Almost at the same time, the other three team members guarding the door rushed in. Two people guarded the front door, and two people quickly walked around to the back door, blocking all escape routes.

The whole process was ridiculously fast. From entering the store to controlling the people, it only took about ten seconds. The vendors setting up stalls nearby and the passers-by didn't even notice what was happening in this small canteen.

Gu Chengan stood under the streetlight at the intersection. Although he couldn't see the situation in the canteen, he could see that the team members at the alley had stabilized their bodies and there was no confusion. The stone hanging in his heart finally fell to the ground and he breathed a sigh of relief.

After a while, in the crowd of people at the entrance of the alley, two plainclothes team members walked out, one on the left and one on the right, holding a man in a black coat. The man's head was drooped, his steps were sloppy, and his whole body seemed to have been stripped of bones. The sleeves of the coat hung down, covering the handcuffs on his wrists.Su Nan followed behind, holding an evidence bag containing Ma Jianguo's ID card and mobile phone, and walked quickly in the direction of Gu Chengan.

Walking closer, Su Nan's tense face finally relaxed: "Confirmed, it's Ma Jianguo. He did it as soon as he was held down. After running for twenty-six years, he was finally caught."

"Okay, Officer Su." Gu Chengan grinned and gave her a thumbs up, with sincere admiration in his tone, "I thought it would take some effort, but I didn't expect it to be done easily, without making any noise, so professional."

"Don't be such a talker." Su Nan couldn't help but smile at him, shook his head, and said seriously, "I really want to thank you this time. This case has been under investigation for twenty-six years, and our police have pursued it in more than a dozen provinces and cities across the country, but there are no clues at all. If you hadn't discovered the clue, we don't know how long he would have been hiding."

"Hey, it's just a little effort." Gu Chengan waved his hand, the smile on his face faded, and he felt a little sour in his heart, "If we can catch this old guy, the abducted children and the family members who are waiting for the news will have an explanation."

Su Nan nodded solemnly, then seemed to remember something, and warned again: "If you encounter this kind of thing in the future, no matter how late it is, remember to call me as soon as possible. Don't stare at it alone. Most of these criminals are so fierce that they are too dangerous."

"Don't worry, I cherish my life very much."

"I'm just a food delivery guy. I only have sharp eyes at most. To catch people, I definitely have to rely on your expertise. By the way, Officer Su, I caught a Class A wanted criminal this time. Can I be rewarded for being a good citizen with courage?" Gu Chengan teased with a smile.

Su Nan was amused by him and laughed out loud, and nodded: "Don't worry! I will submit the materials to you when I get back. Not only will there be an honorary certificate, but there will also be a special bonus. You will definitely be indispensable."

"Then I'll just wait." Gu Chengan smiled with crooked eyebrows.

While talking, the team members had already put Ma Jianguo into the Hongguang car.

Gu Chengan felt inexplicably at ease as he watched the two cars disappear at the intersection.

With a thought in mind, open the system.

【Justice value: 1055】
